teaser.text: Chipotle Mexican Grill is a restaurant business that turns a small set of ingredients into meals chosen one customer at a time. Its economics are equally simple to picture: people pay for food and convenience, while Chipotle pays to buy, prepare, deliver and support that food, and keeps what remains.

stock.title: Chipotle stock forecast
stock.meta_description: Chipotle stock forecast: weighted scenarios, operating drivers, real free cash flow and valuation in plain English.
stock.opening: Chipotle’s weighted forecast reaches $35.36 by October 2029. It hinges on traffic, margins, new-store returns and cash generation.
stock.closing: The full memo also covers Chipotle’s business, rivals, management and risks.

blocks.heading: Where could Chipotle’s shares be by 2029?

paragraphs.text: The forecast puts Chipotle near flat in one year, then modestly higher over three years. The probability-weighted price is $29.82 in October 2027, with a 0% return including dividends, and $32.56 in October 2028, with 10%. It reaches $35.36 in October 2029, with 19%. Today's reference price is $29.68.

blocks.heading: What has to go right for Chipotle’s forecast?

paragraphs.text: The recovery remains restrained because first-half 2026 margin was 11.0%, below 2025's 12.9%, even as sales increased. The bear case gives $1,365M in 2027 and $1,330M in 2029 as weak traffic and rising costs overwhelm openings. The bull case reaches $1,700M and $2,310M because transactions recover beyond guidance and new restaurants earn attractive returns.

blocks.heading: How much cash does Chipotle really make?

paragraphs.text: Capital spending was 666,336 in 2025. Free cash flow was 1,447,590, down from 1,511,473 in 2024. Chipotle builds and maintains almost all its restaurants itself, so expansion consumes cash that a heavily franchised chain might shift to independent operators.

Stock compensation is another owner-level cost. Chipotle paid 119,543 through stock compensation in 2025. Subtracting it produces analytical “real free cash flow” of 1,328,047, because the noncash payment still dilutes shareholders.

blocks.heading: What does an investor pay for Chipotle today?

paragraphs.text: The price-to-earnings ratio, or P/E, tells investors how many dollars they pay for each dollar of annual profit. A lemonade stand earning one dollar a year and selling for twenty-seven dollars has a P/E of twenty-seven. Chipotle’s trailing P/E is 27.2 times, while its forward P/E is 21.6 times because the latter uses estimated future earnings per share. The lower figure is therefore a bet on higher profit, not proof that the shares are cheap.

earnings.title: Chipotle earnings date and guidance
earnings.meta_description: Chipotle's October 28, 2026 results will test low-single-digit comparable-sales growth and 350 to 370 restaurant openings.
earnings.opening: Chipotle's next results are expected on October 28, 2026. For Chipotle, watch whether transactions after July keep improving and whether the raised annual outlook remains intact.
earnings.closing: The full research covers Chipotle's business, rivals, management and risks.

paragraphs.text: Management guidance is the company’s own forecast. On July 29, 2026, Chipotle raised its full-year comparable-sales outlook from roughly flat to low-single-digit growth. Comparable sales measure restaurants open for at least 13 full calendar months, so new locations cannot improve the figure simply by opening.

Capital expenditure, or capex, is spending on assets that last for years, such as buildings, kitchens, equipment and technology. Chipotle’s 2026 capex budget is US$834.1 million. New restaurant construction receives US$531.8 million, while existing restaurants receive US$266.9 million.

blocks.heading: Did Chipotle keep its past promises?

paragraphs.text: Chipotle initially forecast 315–345 company-owned openings for 2025 and delivered 334. Yet established-restaurant sales declined that year. The result shows why opening targets cannot replace a broader performance test. Retention awards granted during the 2024 transition can also continue creating expense during later vesting periods.

blocks.heading: What has Chipotle's revenue and profit done?

paragraphs.text: Revenue reached 3,348,562 in June 2026. That was 9.3% above 3,063,393 a year earlier. Comps rose 2.2%; transactions increased 1.0%, while average check rose 1.2%. Chipotle opened 100 company-owned restaurants, including 80 with a Chipotlane.

Profit moved in the opposite direction. Operating income fell from 559,057 in June 2025 to 525,595 in June 2026. Net income fell from 436,127 to 403,547. Diluted EPS remained 0.32 because fewer shares spread the lower earnings across fewer owners.
